meta.title: Terms & Conditions | Padel2Go
meta.description: General Terms and Conditions of PADEL2GO OpCo UG – terms of use for court bookings and purchases in the PADEL2GO shop.

scope.heading: § 1 Scope
scope.p1Prefix: These General Terms and Conditions (hereinafter "Terms") apply to all contracts concluded between PADEL2GO OpCo UG (haftungsbeschränkt), Am Neudeck 12, 81541 Munich, Germany (hereinafter "PADEL2GO" or "we") and users (hereinafter "users") via the platform
scope.p2: These Terms cover in particular the arrangement and booking of padel courts, the sale of goods via the PADEL2GO shop (marketplace) and the use of associated services (P2G Points, lobbies, community features).
scope.p3: Deviating terms of the user are not recognised unless PADEL2GO expressly agrees to their validity in writing.

registration.heading: § 2 Registration & User Account
registration.p1: Some services require free registration. Registration and the use of paid services require the user to be of legal age. Users must provide truthful and complete information when registering and keep it up to date. Court bookings and shop orders are also possible without registration as a guest; these Terms apply to guest bookings and guest orders as well.
registration.p2: The user account is non-transferable. Users are responsible for all activities carried out under their account and must keep their access credentials confidential.
registration.p3: PADEL2GO reserves the right to temporarily suspend or permanently delete user accounts in the event of violations of these Terms or misuse.

items.label: Booking process:
items.text: By clicking "Book with obligation to pay", the user submits a binding offer to conclude a usage contract for the selected court and time slot. The contract is concluded upon receipt of the payment confirmation.

items.label: Prices:
items.text: All prices stated are final prices in euros including statutory VAT, unless stated otherwise.

items.label: Payment:
items.text: Payment is processed via the payment service provider Stripe. Accepted payment methods are credit and debit cards as well as other methods offered by Stripe. The booking is only confirmed as binding after successful payment.

items.label: Split payment:
items.text: Users can split a booking between several players. The booking user is responsible for full receipt of payment. Unpaid shares will be charged to the booking user unless otherwise agreed in the respective booking details.

items.label: Voucher codes:
items.text: Voucher codes can be redeemed at checkout. A maximum of one voucher code can be used per booking. Vouchers are non-transferable, cannot be combined with other promotions and cannot be redeemed for cash.

cancellation.heading: § 4 Cancellation of Court Bookings; No Right of Withdrawal
cancellation.noWithdrawalText: Pursuant to § 312g (2) no. 9 of the German Civil Code (BGB), there is no statutory right of withdrawal for contracts for leisure services where the provider undertakes to perform the service at a specific time. Court bookings fall under this exemption. Instead, we grant the following cancellation right:
cancellation.userText: Registered users cancel via their user account; guests via the contact channel stated in the booking confirmation (an email is sufficient). The following conditions apply:
userList: Cancellation up to the start of the booked playing time: free of charge, full refund of the amount paid to the original payment method
After the start of the booked playing time or in case of no-show: no refund
cancellation.providerText: In the event of force majeure, technical problems or other unforeseeable events that make it impossible to carry out the booking, the full amount will be refunded.

goods.heading: § 5 Purchase of Goods in the PADEL2GO Shop

items.label: Applicability:
items.text: The following provisions additionally apply to the purchase of goods (e.g. rackets, balls, apparel, accessories) via the PADEL2GO shop.

items.label: Conclusion of contract:
items.text: The product presentation in the shop does not constitute a binding offer. By clicking "Order with obligation to pay", the user submits a binding offer to conclude a purchase contract. The contract is concluded upon receipt of our order confirmation by email, at the latest upon dispatch of the goods.

items.label: Prices & shipping:
items.text: All prices are final prices in euros including statutory VAT. Shipping within Germany is free of charge. Delivery to other countries is currently not possible.

items.label: Delivery time:
items.text: Unless stated otherwise for the respective product, the delivery time is 2–4 business days after receipt of payment.

items.label: Payment:
items.text: Payment is processed via the payment service provider Stripe (card, PayPal). Registered users can pay the purchase price partially or fully with P2G Points (§ 8).

items.label: Retention of title:
items.text: The delivered goods remain the property of PADEL2GO until full payment has been made.

items.label: Warranty:
items.text: The statutory warranty rights apply. Complaints can be sent to info@padel2go-official.de.

withdrawal.heading: § 6 Right of Withdrawal for Purchases of Goods
withdrawal.p1Prefix: Consumers have a statutory right of withdrawal of 14 days from receipt of the goods. The full withdrawal instructions including the model withdrawal form can be found at
withdrawal.p2: PADEL2GO bears the costs of the return shipment.
withdrawal.p3: The right of withdrawal does not apply to goods made to customer specifications or clearly personalised (e.g. individually printed textiles), or to sealed goods that are unsuitable for return for reasons of health protection or hygiene if their seal has been removed after delivery.
withdrawal.p4: There is no right of withdrawal for court bookings (§ 4); the cancellation right granted there applies instead.

userDuties.heading: § 7 User Obligations
list: to use the booked court punctually during the reserved period and to leave it in proper condition
to comply with the usage rules of the respective location
not to make bookings for third parties without their express consent
not to misuse the platform (e.g. manipulation of P2G Points, use of stolen payment data)
not to send automated requests (bots, scraping) to the platform
userDuties.outro: In the event of violations of these obligations, PADEL2GO reserves the right to assert claims for damages and to suspend the user account.

rewards.heading: § 8 P2G Points & Loyalty Programme
rewards.p1: PADEL2GO operates a voluntary loyalty programme. Registered users receive P2G Points for paid court bookings. Points are not sold and cannot be purchased.
rewards.p2: Points can only be redeemed as a discount in the PADEL2GO shop. Currently, 100 points equal a discount of €1.00; a maximum of 50% of the order value can be paid with points per order. Points are not legal tender, are non-transferable and are not paid out in cash.
rewards.p3: Points expire 36 months after they are credited. If a booking is cancelled or an order is reversed, points credited or redeemed for it will be reversed accordingly.
rewards.p4: PADEL2GO may adapt or discontinue the loyalty programme with effect for the future, insofar as this is reasonable taking into account the legitimate interests of users. In this case, points already collected can still be redeemed for at least 3 months. In the event of misuse (e.g. manipulation), points may be revoked.

liability.heading: § 9 Liability
liability.p1: PADEL2GO is liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence as well as for damages resulting from injury to life, body or health.
liability.p2: In the event of slight negligence, PADEL2GO is only liable for breaches of essential contractual obligations (cardinal obligations) and only up to the amount of foreseeable damage typical for the contract. Any further liability is excluded.
liability.intro: Subject to the preceding paragraphs, PADEL2GO accepts no liability in particular for:
list: Damage caused by the user or by the respective court operator
Technical failures of third-party services (esp. Stripe, Supabase)
Loss of or damage to the user's belongings at the location

final.p1: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG).
final.p2: For consumers, this choice of law only applies insofar as it does not deprive them of mandatory consumer protection provisions of the state in which they have their habitual residence.
